Item Species Management Units Open Season
Youth seasons
19 The following open seasons, excepting bow only seasons, are restricted to persons who are less than 18 years of age: (a)the open seasons for hunting white-tailed deer bucks in M.U.s 6-1 to 6-11, 6-14, 6-15 and 6-30 from September 1 to September 9 and from December 11 to December 20; (b)the open season for hunting antlerless white-tailed deer in M.U.s 6-1 to 6-11, 6-14, 6-15 and 6-30 from December 1 to December 20. [en. B.C. Reg. 97/2026, App. 3, s. 12 (d).] Part 3 — Bag Limits and Possession Limits
